event_id.description: The event this submission relates to, copied from the form's related_event_id at submission time (for event-linked forms) or stamped server-side from a survey event assignment. Null for forms not linked to an event.

complex_event_id.description: The complex (multi-session) event this survey response relates to, stamped server-side from the resolved survey event assignment. Null for non-assignment submissions and simple-event assignments.

survey_assignment_id.description: The event survey assignment this response arrived through (server-resolved from the assignment token). Null for direct/non-survey submissions.

submission_data.description: The submitted form data as key-value pairs

status_updated_by.description: Email of the user who last updated the status

payment_status.description: Task #3483 generic form Payment field lifecycle. 'pending' rows were created before the provider payment started and are excluded from normal admin listings and all post-submission side effects; 'paid' rows completed payment (finalisation runs exactly once); 'failed' rows had their payment cancelled/failed. Null for submissions without payment.

payment_provider.description: Which provider took (or was asked to take) the payment.

payment_amount.description: Amount in major units, ALWAYS derived server-side from the payment field's price-source answer — never client-supplied.

payment_currency.description: ISO currency code for payment_amount (e.g. GBP).

payment_reference.description: Provider-side reference: Stripe PaymentIntent id or GoCardless billing request id.

payment_meta.description: Payment bookkeeping: price_field_id, gc_flow_id, prefill/role context captured at create, and the finalized/finalized_at exactly-once stamp for post-payment side effects.

payment_paid_at.description: When the payment was verified as complete.

status_updated_at.description: When the status was last updated

survey_version_id.description: Published survey version this submission was scored against (surveys only).

survey_score_weighted.description: Cached weighted overall score (0..1), computed server-side.

survey_score_unweighted.description: Cached unweighted overall score (0..1), computed server-side.

is_anonymous.description: True when the survey suppressed respondent identity.

survey_respondent_key.description: One-way hash used for duplicate prevention on anonymous surveys; never reversible to identity.
